banner: Educational prototype · Solana test network · No real money
tagline: Every transfer splits. Part takes root.
landing.lead: Send money home. Save a little every time, automatically.
landing.demoHint: No wallet needed. You get a practice wallet with test dollars.
landing.or: or use your own devnet wallet
landing.step1.title: Set your split
landing.step1.text: Choose once how much of each transfer goes into savings, from 0% to 50%.
landing.step2.title: Send
landing.step2.text: One transaction pays your family and buys a savings bond at the same moment.
landing.step3.title: Watch it grow
landing.step3.text: Anyone can see how much the bond raised and how the money was used.
landing.disclaimer: A model for regulators and licensed remittance operators to evaluate.
demo.failed: The practice wallet could not be set up.
send.title: Send money home
send.needWallet.title: Start with a practice wallet
send.needWallet.text: You need a wallet with test dollars to send. The demo sets one up for you in a few seconds.
send.projection.title: In 12 months at this rate:
send.projection.note: An illustration for 12 monthly transfers, not a promise.
send.recipientInvalid: Enter a valid Solana address for your family.

bond.proceeds.title: Where the money went
